premise: Do the genes a rule caught run differently through the measurements than everything else, or does the rule relabel the middle? Two axes show a pair; a matrix of scatters hides the gene that is extreme in one measurement and ordinary in four, which is the shape of every finding here.
sampling: Both layers are sampled, and neither is the corpus. Each rule contributes at most 260 lines so no single one floods the ink (1,544 of 3,175 flagged genes); the ground is every 9th unflagged gene (1,647 of 14,819). Keeping every flagged gene made a plot in which the flagged were the corpus, and the background stopped being something to judge difference against.
